title: Severn's Sewer Key
summary: Unlocks the No Entry – No Exit double door to the Guildhall.

fields.Use: Door is in the Lower City Sewers near X −14, Y 775. DC 20 Sleight of Hand is an alternative.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Severn, the Guildhall bartender.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
